name: Packleader Ivar Bloodfang
summary: Packleader Ivar Bloodfang is the cunning and ruthless leader of the Bloodfang worgen pack prowling Silverpine Forest. Driven by a bitter vendetta against the Forsaken, he commands feral wolf-men across the dark woods and broken ruins of northern Lordaeron.

sections.title: Alpha of the Bloodfang
sections.body: Unlike ordinary feral beasts who mindlessly tear through the woods, Ivar Bloodfang possesses a keen mind and ruthless strategic acumen. As packleader, he coordinates his worgen pack in calculated ambushes and skirmishes across Silverpine Forest. He demonstrates that despite the feral curse gripping his followers, they are capable of disciplined, coordinated savagery when bent toward survival and revenge.

sections.title: A Hatred Born in Ash
sections.body: Ivar's driving motivation is an unyielding, lethal hatred for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and her Forsaken. He considers the undead to be sworn blood enemies encroaching upon the wild remnants of Lordaeron. Any strike against Forsaken holdings, patrol roads, or outposts is considered fair game by the Bloodfang pack, making traveling through Silverpine an ordeal fraught with ambushes from the moonlit shadows.

faq.answer: He is the leader of the Bloodfang pack, a vicious clan of worgen roaming the shadowy woodlands of Silverpine Forest. Known for his tactical cunning and sheer brutality, he leads his pack in a relentless campaign against the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does Ivar Bloodfang hate the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Ivar views the undead Forsaken as abominations spreading corruption across Lordaeron's forests. He considers them blood enemies who must be excised through ruthless violence and savage ambushes.

faq.q: Where does the Bloodfang pack operate?
faq.answer: The Bloodfang pack stalks the dark forests and shadowed valleys of Silverpine Forest, threatening anyone traveling north toward the Tirisfal Glades or south toward the Greymane Wall.
No. Despite succumbing to the worgen curse and displaying unhesitating brutality, Ivar retains sharp tactical intelligence and can organize his followers into a coordinated fighting force.

faq.q: Is Ivar aligned with the Alliance?
faq.answer: Ivar is willing to make practical alliances when it serves the survival and retribution of his pack, sharing common enemies like the Horde and Forsaken, though his primary loyalty remains solely to the Bloodfang.

faq.q: How does Ivar control his pack?
faq.answer: Through raw dominance, sheer ferocity, and cunning leadership. Worgen society mirrors predatory wolf hierarchy, where the strongest and most cunning alpha commands obedience.

angles.text: The Bloodfang pack represents an omnipresent, howling threat in the forests of Silverpine, ambushing Forsaken patrols with relentless bloodlust.
Any Horde traveler journeying through Silverpine must stay vigilant, as Ivar's pack attacks supply lines and scouts without hesitation.
Worgen pack tactics commanded by an alpha like Ivar display the pinnacle of predatory cunning, blending animal fury with calculating coordination.
